_meta.name: Quebec 1989 Blackout
_meta.notes: Hydro-Québec grid collapse. 6 million people lost power for 9+ hours. Caused by GICs from a CME impact at 2000 km/s. First major grid blackout attributed to space weather.
_meta.impact: Complete grid collapse in Quebec, transformer damage in NJ/US, satellite anomalies, aurora to Texas/Florida
